title: Cabbage Rolls Stuffed with Bulgur and Chickpeas
subtitle: with lemon and garlic sauce
description: Cabbage leaves rolled around a bulgur, chickpea and tomato filling, simmered until tender and served with a lemon, garlic and mint sauce.

steps.text: Blanch the separated cabbage leaves in boiling water for about 2 minutes until slightly softened. Cut along each leaf, remove the central vein and set it aside. If a leaf is very large, cut each piece in half.

Heat half the olive oil in a frying pan and fry the chopped onion until golden. Add the tomato paste and fry for about 1 minute. Add the chopped tomatoes and fry for about 1 minute. Remove from the heat and add the bulgur, chickpeas and spices (cinnamon, basil, baharat, salt and pepper) and mix.
Place the cabbage leaves on the work surface, put a heaped tablespoon of filling at the edge of each leaf and roll up, folding in the sides.

Arrange the reserved cabbage veins at the bottom of a pot and place the stuffed rolls on top. Put an upturned plate on top so they do not move and add water to cover. Add salt and the remaining olive oil. Cover the pot, bring to the boil, reduce the heat and cook for about 1 hour until the water is absorbed.
Mix the sauce ingredients (juice of 2 lemons, crushed garlic and dried mint), arrange the rolls on a serving plate, pour over a little of the sauce and serve hot or cold.
